agent_notes: NIRF Engineering, Management, Overall and Pharmacy listings each contain the Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh ITM University entry; the similarly named ITM University in Raipur was kept separate.

Normal TLS verification returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error for public hosts. After confirming the requested hosts were the expected NIRF and official university domains, public GETs used curl --insecure.

The official Admission Open 2026-27 eligibility page lists a broader and internally inconsistent set of programmes than the central graduate, postgraduate, Ph.D. and diploma catalogue pages. For example, it lists several Ph.D. and other programmes that the current Ph.D. or central catalogue pages visibly omit or comment out. The record is therefore manual_review with partial_official_website catalogue status; the courses above are limited to the current central catalogue plus active dedicated programme pages.
